## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c0052db4f5fa47abc0b360ebe9867d111ffb8adf`

Rendered by an isolated review subagent spawned by the `domain:ui#4` seat; its served tier was checked against its transcript stamps (136 of 136 model stamps at the review tier). Adopted by this seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **(a) The link resolves.** Traced through the real tables at head. Console `App.tsx` declares `/apps/:appName/*` (element `AppContent`, protected) and a trailing `*` that renders `RedirectWithSplash` to `/`; it declares no `/developer` path and no `/console` path. Console `AppContent` wraps app-shell's `DefaultAppContent` with `extraRoutes` and `extraRoutesNoApp` both set to `systemRoutes`, which carries `developer/api-console`. app-shell `AppContent`'s with-app branch declares `component/:ns/:name/*` (element `ComponentNavView`), `metadata/:type/:name` (element `MetadataResourceEditPage`) and `{extraRoutes}`; the no-active-app branch declares `metadata/:type/:name` and `{extraRoutesNoApp}` and no generic `component/...` route (only the legacy `component/metadata/...` redirects). `ComponentNavView` joins `:ns` and `:name` with a colon, looks `developer:api-console` up in the registry, and renders the registered component with the query string spread as string props. `registerDeveloperComponents.tsx` registers that key as a `Suspense` wrapper around the lazy `ApiConsolePage`, which declares no props. So `/apps/APP/component/developer/api-console?path=...&method=POST` reaches `ApiConsolePage` with the query intact; no route consumes the query and the router location is one object at every nesting level. Pinned end to end by the console test through the real `DefaultAppContent` and the real `systemRoutes`.
  - Same builder as the Studio sidebar: `componentRefToUrlSegments` is `ref.split(':').filter(Boolean)` in app-shell's `componentRegistry.ts`. The sidebar's href for a `component` nav item is built in `@object-ui/layout` (`resolveHref` in `NavigationRenderer.tsx`, and `AppSchemaRenderer.tsx`) as `${basePath}/component/${segs.join('/')}` with `segs = ref.split(':').filter(Boolean)` and `basePath` equal to `/apps/APP` (`UnifiedSidebar.tsx`). Same algorithm and same URL shape, not the same function: layout sits below app-shell and cannot import the helper. objectstack `studio.app.ts` names `componentRef: 'developer:api-console'` with no params in `group_developer`, so the sidebar entry and the preview link land on the identical path. The changeset sentence about the path Studio's Developer navigation reaches is true.
  - `useParams().appName` where the preview renders: `ResourceEditPage` renders the registered preview (`getMetadataPreview(type)`) inline, with no nested Routes element and no second React root, as the element of `metadata/:type/:name` in both `AppContent` branches, nested under the root `/apps/:appName/*`. react-router merges ancestor params into descendant matches, so `appName` is in scope there. Studio's `metadata:resource` item with `params.type: 'tool'` resolves through NavigationRenderer's metadata special case to `/apps/APP/metadata/tool`, matching M1. The `/studio/:packageId/:tab` surface has three pillars (data, automations, interfaces) and maps no `tool` type; if a tool preview ever rendered without an app, the outcome is no link, not a throw.
  - Basename with a new tab: `Link` computes its `href` through `useHref`, which joins the router basename onto the resolved pathname before `createHref`; a `target` of `_blank` makes the router's click handler leave the click to the browser, which opens that basename-qualified `href`. The console resolves its basename from an injected base element (`resolveBasename` in `App.tsx`; `vite.config.ts` names `/_console/` as a mount point). Pinned with a real `MemoryRouter` under basename `/_console`. Sound.
  - The split into `ApiConsoleLink` (one unconditional `useInRouterContext` call) and `RoutedApiConsoleLink` (one unconditional `useParams` call) keeps each component's hook order constant, and whether a router sits above a mount cannot change during that mount. Sound; pinned as no link and no throw with no router.
- **(b) The preset read.** `readRequestPreset(searchParams)` runs inside a `useState` lazy initialiser, so once per mount, and `methodOverride` and `urlOverride` are seeded from it once. No effect reads `preset` or `searchParams` afterwards (the other `preset` identifiers in the file belong to the pre-existing `QUERY_PARAM_PRESETS` chips). Pinned: a later `navigate` to a different query leaves the editor unchanged. It holds on both mounts: `useSearchParams` reads the router's current location, which is the page's own URL under `developer/api-console` and under `ComponentNavView` alike; nothing keys the element on the search string, and the registered wrapper is a module-scope function, so a query change re-renders without remounting. Under `ComponentNavView` the query also arrives as props, which `ApiConsolePage()` does not declare. Both mounts pinned through the real route table.
- **(c) Security and safety of the preset.** The guard is `path.startsWith('/api/')`; the send path is `${client.baseUrl}${effectiveUrl}` with `baseUrl` equal to `VITE_SERVER_URL` or empty (`AdapterProvider`). A value that passes the guard begins with a slash followed by `a`, so it can be neither a scheme-relative `//host` reference nor carry a scheme; appended after a configured origin, or resolved as a rooted path against the page origin, the authority is fixed before the path is parsed. `/api/\\evil` is a path with a backslash (the URL parser treats it as a slash for http), `/api//evil.com` is a path with an empty segment, `/api/..%2F..` keeps its percent-encoded characters as a literal segment. None leaves the origin. One nuance the header over-states: `/api/../x` passes the guard and normalises to `/x` on the same origin, so this is a same-origin guard rather than an under-`/api/` guard; the literal string is what the URL field shows before Send. Not a defect: the stated threat, aiming the request editor at another origin, is closed. Nothing is sent on load: `sendRequest` is called only from the Send button's `onClick` and from Enter in the URL field; no effect calls it and the discovery hook reads no query string. Pinned: no fetch to `/ai/tools/` with the preset present. A crafted link can pre-fill `DELETE` on a `/api/v1/data/...` path. The verb shows in the method selector with its red colouring, the path in the URL field, the body is empty, and Send must be pressed; the console is an authenticated developer tool and the same request could be typed. Judgment: acceptable, the residual risk is social. A marker that the preset came from a link would be a nice-to-have, not a requirement.
- **(d) The tool execute endpoint.** objectstack `origin/main` (`949e99bed9`) carries no `service-ai` package and no `buildToolRoutes` symbol anywhere in the tree: `packages/runtime/src/domains/ai.ts` dispatches the `/ai/**` family to "the AI service's registered route handlers" and describes `service-ai` as a Cloud/Enterprise package absent on an open-edition boot (501). The builder's source is therefore out of this review's reach. Every in-tree reference at that sha agrees on path and verb: `docs/audits/2026-06-toolschema-property-liveness.md` ("the route is `/ai/tools/:toolName/execute`", citing `tool-routes.ts`), `packages/spec/src/ai/tool.zod.ts` (`POST /ai/tools/:name/execute`), `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` (`POST /ai/tools/:tool/execute`) and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/ai.json` (`POST /api/v1/ai/tools/qa_probe_tool/execute`). objectui's `useApiDiscovery.ts` mirrors the cloud ledger with `POST` `/tools/:toolName/execute` under `/api/v1/ai` and a `{ parameters: {} }` body template. `method=POST` is right. The `buildToolRoutes` name in the ToolPreview docblock is inherited from the pre-fix comment and is unverifiable from objectstack main.
- **(e) Behaviour changes beyond the card.** The designer gallery (`preview-gallery.tsx`) mounts previews with no router and lists `tool`, so its tool card now shows no link; disclosed in the PR body (M1 and Acceptance notes) and in the changeset; acceptable, since the old link there was a dead URL. `REQUEST_METHODS` is `['GET', 'POST', 'PATCH', 'PUT', 'DELETE']`, identical in members and order to the inline list it replaces, and `HttpMethod` is that same five-member union; disclosed in the PR body; acceptable. Nothing else: the `ToolPreview.tsx` diff is the docblock pointer, three imports, `API_CONSOLE_REF`, the two link components and the toolbar expression; the `ApiConsolePage.tsx` diff is the header, one import, the constant, `readRequestPreset`, the `useSearchParams` and `useState` pair, two seeded initial states and the selector's list. `sendRequest`, `replayHistoryEntry` and the `history` state are untouched.
- **(f) The pins are real.** `ToolPreview.test.tsx` adds 9 `it` blocks in a real `MemoryRouter` with two routes and no module mock; the same-builder pin imports the real `componentRefToUrlSegments`. `ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx` has 12 `it` blocks (pre-fill, control, four ignore cases, method case, read-once; end to end, two mounts, harness control) over the real page, the real `registerDeveloperComponents`, the real `DefaultAppContent` and the real `systemRoutes`. Reverse arithmetic re-derived from the case lists: restoring the old href string inside the `to` expression reddens the six href pins (registry-key path, same-builder path, other app, path plus method, escaping round-trip, basename) and the console end-to-end pin, 7 of 28; nulling the lazy initialiser reddens pre-fill, method case, read-once, end to end and both mounts, 6 of 12, with control, the four ignore cases and the harness control green; dropping the `/api/` guard reddens absolute, protocol-relative and outside-`/api/`, 3 of 12, the empty value still refused by the null check. All three match the dev's counts. Mocks: the console pins stub the shell chrome, `useAuth`, `useMetadata` (two apps so `/apps/studio` resolves), `useAdapter` (no client, so `baseUrl` is empty) and `fetch` (a 404 recorder, which is what the no-send assertion reads). `getMetadataPreview` and the `tool` registration arrive through the package entry's `register-builtins.js`, outside the mocked `views/metadata-admin` index, so the end-to-end pin draws the real link. `MetadataResourceEditPage` is stubbed, so the step "the preview lives inside ResourceEditPage with `appName` in scope" rests on the route-table reading in (a), not on a pin. No pin is tautological.
- **(g) Changeset truth.** `.changeset/10591-tool-preview-api-console-link.md` declares `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console` `patch`; both are in the `fixed` group. Every sentence re-derived at head: the old bare href and its catch-all redirect, the missing query read, the registry-key path and its equality with the Studio nav path, the `path` and `method` query, the router basename and the new tab, the no-router and no-app no-link rule, the once-on-mount read, the no-send rule, both mounts, the `/api/` guard with its three ignored shapes, the method rule, and "opens exactly as before" (a null preset seeds both states with their former empty values). No line-address citation. Other pending changesets naming these surfaces: `10520-orphaned-console-pages.md` (the four `/apps/:app/developer/` routes unchanged and `developer:api-console` named by Studio: still true), `5291-api-console-storage-slot.md` (`useApiDiscovery` untouched: still true), `previews-shared-empty-description-8526.md` (`ToolPreview` still renders `EmptyDescription` at `text-xs` with no local `Empty`: still true). No sentence is now false.
- **(h) Out-of-scope finding, class a: confirmed.** `AgentPreview.tsx` builds `chatUrl` as `/console/ai/agents/NAME/chat` and renders it as a plain anchor with `target` `_blank`. The root table in `App.tsx` and `StudioRoute.tsx` declare no path beginning with `/console`; the chat routes are `/ai`, `/ai/:agent` and `/ai/:agent/:conversationId`. The anchor matches only the trailing `*` redirect home, and as a plain anchor it also ignores the router basename. Same shape as this card.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on both packages is right and the changeset agrees. objectui AGENTS.md's version rule: "minor/patch **独立演进**——objectstack 没动时不必跟发;objectui 自己的改动照常用 changeset 推进" and "changeset 里不要声明 `major` … objectui 自身的破坏性变更也标 `minor`". This is a bug fix: a dead link now resolves and a dropped preset is honoured. The diff adds no `export`; `REQUEST_METHODS` and `readRequestPreset` are module-private; `ToolPreview` still takes `MetadataPreviewProps`; no route, spec key or exported type is added or removed. Not `major`.

`Clause-②: no` stands. The pm-dispatch criterion ("判据:本卡放宽接受集或扩大公开面吗"; "条款②只指已发布契约面"; the published surface being the packages' `exports` map) is not met. `path` and `method` are page-scoped URL query parameters of one host page, produced and consumed inside the same fixed release group; they are not an exported type, a prop, a spec key or an accept set. app-shell's `urlParams.ts` itself classes such names as page-scoped and unreserved, and neither collides with a reserved name. It is a UI deep-link detail.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Model identifiers: none in the four commit messages, their trailers, the PR title or the body; the only trailers are the co-author line and the session-link line.
- File surface, 5 files against the claim: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ToolPreview.tsx` (the link's construction only), `ToolPreview.test.tsx` beside it, `apps/console/src/pages/developer/ApiConsolePage.tsx` (the query read, plus the selector rendering the shared verb list), the new `ApiConsolePage.requestPreset-10591.test.tsx` beside it, and one changeset declaring both packages (the claim's "changesets for both" is the same declaration in one file). `apps/console/src/App.tsx`, `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx` and `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` are untouched, so no route-table change; `sendRequest`, `replayHistoryEntry` and `history` are untouched, so no change to sending or history.
